title: Operational Flow Order — System-Wide Demand Reduction Required
flow_detail: An Operational Flow Order (OFO) has been issued effective 10:00 AM on 5/25/2026. All shippers on Zone 4 are required to reduce scheduled volumes to no more than 90% of nominated quantities. Failure to comply will result in imbalance charges at 200% of the spot price.

title: Unplanned Outage — Mainline Valve Replacement, Station 195
flow_detail: An unplanned emergency outage began at 04:00 on 5/26/2026 due to a failed mainline valve at Station 195. Zone 5 south of Station 195 is currently isolated. No estimated restoration time available.

title: Force Majeure — Tornado Damage, Kansas Compressor Station 8
flow_detail: Force Majeure declared effective 11:30 AM CT on May 26, 2026. Severe tornado damage to Kansas Compressor Station 8 has caused complete loss of compression on the Hugoton Lateral. All receipts from the Hugoton field are suspended until further notice.

title: Upcoming Maintenance — Line 100-1 MP 842–861 Hydrostatic Test
flow_detail: Hydrostatic pressure testing on Line 100-1 between MP 842 and MP 861 in Zone 6. Northbound capacity reduced to 980,000 Dth/d. Interruptible and secondary firm service south of MP 842 will be curtailed.

title: Capacity Constraint — Gulf Mainline Segment 22 Hydrostatic Test
flow_detail: Planned hydrostatic testing on Segment 22 will restrict northbound capacity to 750,000 Dth/d. Interruptible receipts at Lebanon Junction will be reduced proportionally.

title: Compressor Station 115 — Planned Maintenance Outage
flow_detail: Scheduled maintenance on Unit 3 at Compressor Station 115 will reduce available firm capacity by approximately 350,000 Dth/d in Market Zone M-3. Interruptible service may be curtailed during the maintenance window.

title: Reduced Deliverability — Oakford Storage Pool, Off-Rate Compressor
flow_detail: Units 4 and 5 at Oakford Storage are currently off-rate due to unplanned mechanical issues. Maximum withdrawal capability is reduced to approximately 620,000 Dth/d until repairs are complete.

title: Annual Pig Run — South Louisiana Mainline Inline Inspection
flow_detail: Annual inline inspection pig run on the South Louisiana Mainline. No capacity interruptions anticipated; minor pressure fluctuations expected during the 14-hour window.
